notes.title: (REAL) new movement tech bagelball 0.8.7 ACTUALLY WORKS NOW
notes.content: [list][*][p]Changed fast-fall to be more of a ground-pound, instantly switches your velocity downwards[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When you hit the ground after fast-falling, you can quickly jump for a super jump[/p][/*][*][p]When going at terminal velocity this super jump maintains speed[/p][/*][*][p]Added bunny-hopping into the game to maintain speed (if you jump quickly after hitting the ground, you retain your speed you had in the air. You can't gain speed this way)[/p][/*][*][p]Added shadows to all the maps[/p][/*][*][p]Made warehouse a bit brighter[/p][/*][*][p]Made wall jump more consistent (should work when scaling maps)[/p][/*][*][p]You can also now wall jump off a bagel which is interesting but largely pointless[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Funny steamworks business[/u][/p][p][/p][p]For reasons beyond my comprehension, steamworks has decided bagelball 0.8.6 is the ultimate copy and will overwrite any other file named bagelball.exe with the 0.8.6 version of bagelball. To get around this, I have renamed the bagelball 0.8.7 file to bagelball real.exe. This means steam download 2 copies of bagelball. bagelball real.exe is the one that runs when you click play.[/p][p][/p][p]This means for now the game has doubled in size lol. I've submitted a ticket to steamworks support so it'll probably be fine soon.[/p]

notes.title: BAGELBALL TOURNAMENT 1 24/05/2025
notes.content:
join the discord to participate: https://discord.com/invite/WZUTqWG3XN

will be held on 24th May at 6PM BST

Tournament Ruleset:
- 1v1
- Quantum Bagels Disabled
- Single bracket elimination, no loser's bracket
- Allowed maps are Warehouse & Cylinder
- First map is decided by coinflip, then the loser gets to pick the map
- Games will be 5 minutes long
- Best of 3 games wins the set
- Winner of the set progresses through the bracket until only one bagel champion remains

Other Information:
- I will be spectating and hosting every match in-game (unless way more people sign up than I expect)
- I will be recording the matches (I plan to make a tournament highlights video)
- I will also be streaming the matches on twitch
- Prize for winning will be a bagel champion role in the discord

notes.title: TEAM SIZE NO RESTRICTIONS SWITCH TEAMS V0.8.3
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]New custom gamemode, allowing for up to 32 players
[*]Ability to switch teams in lobby, allowing unbalanced matches if you want
[*]Quantum Bagel Switch is now only available when its not held by a player
[*]Added 0.1s buffer so that once dropped, Quantum Bagel Switch can't be used for 0.1s
[list]
[*]The goal of these quantum bagel changes was to prevent spamming right click from being viable movement, and this prevents you spamming left click right click, since you could imitate the same movement like this.
[/list]
[*]Added quantum bagels to practice mode
[*]New spawning method that is infinitely scalable (more for me)
[*]Added a goal score noise to spectator
[*]Golden goal now resets spectators
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Can no longer hold two bagels if you pick up a bagel, then quantum switch
[*]Added the pre-game countdown to be controlled by the SFX volume slider
[*]The game now focusses itself as a window when start game is pressed, previously if the game was minimised it just crashed.
[/list]

notes.title: custom lobby variables & countdown 0.8.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added custom lobby variables
[list]
[*]Gravity
[*]Match Length
[*]Engine Timescale
[*]Map Scale (suggestion from bug)
[/list]
[*]Added a countdown once both players have loaded in to start the game (this should fix a bug where players have their clock desynced by 3 seconds if they load in 3 seconds late)
[*]Changed netcode a little to make non-host players interact with the ball better. However it may make input delay unbearable if playing with high ping, not sure. will have to see.
[*]fixed goals during the countdown to golden goal being counted
[/list]

It's really easy to break the game with the custom lobby variables, especially with negative map scales. all good fun though.
